verdict.rationale: BigQuery's docs show IAM predefined roles and granular permissions that apply to datasets, tables, views, and routines, so role-based access at the table level is documented. Nothing in the evidence covers the column, row, or masking layers the story requires. missing for 10: column-level access control, row-level security/row access policies, dynamic data masking policies, independent or hands-on corroboration of multi-team governance
